description: For agencies: which brands share the account’s balance and which are BILLED SEPARATELY (a brand that pays from its own balance, with its own Stripe customer, so a client can fund their own work). Action list (default): each brand, its balance if separate, its external id. Separate: turn separate billing on or off for one brand (ACCOUNT HOLDER ONLY; it changes who pays, so call once without confirm, tell the user what changes, then again with confirm:true). Checkout_link: a hosted Stripe payment link (a credit pack by id, or a monthly plan) that funds a separately billed brand’s own balance; anyone with the link can pay it, nothing is charged until they do. Admins and billing managers of the brand can make one. Free.

brand.description: brand id or name (list_brands); on list, only that brand

confirm.description: separate: true only after the user agreed

id.description: checkout_link: the pack or plan id (hermoso_capabilities lists them)

kind.description: checkout_link: a credit pack (default) or a monthly plan

on.description: separate: true bills the brand separately, false puts it back on the account’s balance

name: brand_billing
title: Billing per brand
